subject.title: [Bug]: Multiple independent paths cause duplicate Telegram messages

question: Should this umbrella remain the canonical tracker for the unrooted yield-time duplicate and residual post-send restart race, or should maintainers split those into separately reproducible issues before accepting another repair?
rationale: The only remaining reported Path 3 mechanism was explicitly invalidated, while the residual Path 4 behavior is characterized in the discussion as a product decision after the primary trigger was mitigated.

options.title: Keep as coordinated umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue for cross-path duplicate-delivery evidence, but require any proposed fix to name and reproduce one specific current-main mechanism.

options.title: Split residual investigations
options.body: Create separate narrowly scoped reports for yielded-session duplication and post-send restart recovery so each can carry a verified reproducer and invariant.

recommendation.title: Keep as coordinated umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain this issue for cross-path duplicate-delivery evidence, but require any proposed fix to name and reproduce one specific current-main mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: Their evidenced Path 2 drain-side hardening is the closest current delivery-contract ownership signal in the supplied history.
